answer: To sell a glacier runoff signal for saffron irrigation, AI keys face a proposed storage gate. Auditors assign each key a disjoint 1 GB archive shard and check fresh random-block Merkle proofs against fixed roots daily; late or invalid proofs deny payment. Assuming incompressible shards and deadlines too short to refetch, ten keys need 10 GB continuously. Shared hosts and parallel keys cannot reuse shards. Disks are reusable capital; power/rent recur, no stake. Sampling can miss deletion; slow honest links can fail. Outsourcing still requires the aggregate storage.
